soundness_flags.label: thm:projected-construction
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted coordinate identity omits the surgical case for interventions on Y: under do(Y=y), Y_j=y rather than B_{C_j,delta_X(H_j,Z_{s,j})}.

soundness_flags.label: ass:pre-treatment; ass:context-only-selector; ass:response-modularity
soundness_flags.one_line: These conditions follow from the already-defined equations C=U_C, Y=B_{C,X}, and the definition of sigma_s as replacement only of the X equation; retain them as construction facts rather than independent class assumptions.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:projected-construction and thm:fixed-map-obstruction
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The residual law P_s(Z_s|U_C) varies with the selector; no common canonical Equation-11 Layer-3 map is asserted.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The sharp envelope is conditional on selector-by-selector Definition-6 projections with selector-specific residual laws, while the low-level response SCM remains common.

source_verification_receipts.locator: official proceedings page, abstract and bibliographic record, lines 8–16 and 21–37
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper introduces projected abstractions for lossy representations, constructs them from a low-level model, translates causal queries, and gives graphical identification criteria.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1–4, especially pp. 3–4; Theorems 2.4–2.6 on pp. 17–23
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Voronin establishes pointwise root-n inference, proves impossibility of unrestricted uniform LP-value estimation, proves uniform consistency under a delta-condition, and explicitly leaves uniform inference under further regularity for future work.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the all-intervention statement with an explicit Y-intervention branch, and move the three construction-implied assumptions into the SCM/selector definitions.

State the uniform result against Voronin’s delta-condition precisely: specify a triangular-array primitive CLT and multiplier approximation, then prove whether the margin rate kappa_n is sufficient, necessary, or impossible for simultaneous endpoint coverage.

Make the field contribution rest on a non-definitional boundary theorem: give a sharp changing-support coverage threshold or a matching failure sequence, rather than presenting the SCM relabeling and finite transport identity as the main mathematical advance.

recommended_next_step: Revise the surgery identity and redundant assumption set, then advance the uniform changing-support inference question as the non-routine field-level kernel.
